channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Narayana Murthy once wanted to work at Wipro. Why did Azim Premji turn him down? Here’s the story
item.description: Infosys founder Narayana Murthy once applied for a job at Wipro but Azim Premji turned him down. Years later, Premji called it one of his biggest mistakes.

item.title: Airtel's premiumization strategy drives strong Q2 revenue and Ebitda growth
item.description: Higher Arpu, postpaid additions and a strong Africa business lifted Airtel's September-quarter performance, even as net profit missed estimates and mobile subscriber additions slowed.

item.title: IDBI Bank stake sale: Why employees are protesting against Fairfax deal and demanding privatisation rollback
item.description: The proposed transaction, approved by the Indian government on October 14, involves the sale of a combined 60.72% stake held by the Centre and Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) to Fairfax.

item.title: Why has ED attached ₹510 crore in Reliance Anil Ambani Group assets? 2 chartered planes, properties among those seized
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) on Tuesday said it has attached ₹510.17 crore worth of properties of Reliance Anil Ambani Group in connection with its ongoing alleged bank fraud cases involving its group companies.

item.title: Temple run: hotel chains chase footfalls over big profits in pilgrim centres
item.description: Radisson, Wyndham, Tamara and Alivaa are adding rooms in religious destinations, betting on domestic travel. But short stays and modest room rates can limit returns for mid-market hotels.

item.title: Client demand for shorter AI deals reshapes Google's cloud market battle
item.description: To be sure, cloud providers aren't the only ones seeing this shift. India's top IT services firms, which once relied on five-year, billion-dollar deals, are also increasingly reporting shorter deal tenures amid the rise of AI.

item.title: Crown new materials stock surge: How an ex-school teacher who left his job to make adhesive tapes became a billionaire
item.description: Chinese materials maker Crown New Materials raised CNY 956 million in its debut, with shares surging as much as 787%. The listing lifted co-founders Mai Michael and Mai Huixia to billionaire status,. The company supplies adhesive materials and films to customers including BYD, Apple and Tesla.

item.title: Google voluntary buyout: What do employees get in severance package? Which 7 countries are included? Explained
item.description: Google is using selective voluntary buyouts to manage costs and redirect resources toward AI and cloud computing. The offers cover employees in five countries, but the company has not disclosed full terms or take-up numbers. The approach follows earlier, division-specific exit programs.

item.title: Richest man on earth Elon Musk spent $224 mn to influence Texas Senate race? What Democrat win means for Tesla, SpaceX
item.description: The 2026 midterms delivered a major Democratic victory, including historic wins in Texas. Musk’s support for Republican candidates failed to prevent Democratic victories in Senate and governor’s races. The results could affect his Texas-based businesses and plans to expand AI infrastructure there.

item.title: Jungle Ventures targets two IPOs a year from its portfolio
item.description: The early-stage VC firm is preparing startups such as Moglix and Livspace for public markets while closing in on a fifth fund that will push its India bets past $1 billion.

item.title: From tunnel boring machines to rockets and pod taxis, L&T explores new manufacturing bets
item.description: Larsen and Toubro is exploring at least half a dozen new businesses ranging from nuclear fuel rods and tunnel boring machines to rockets and drones and their components

item.title: FitLab Blames Bankruptcy on Loss of Nike Partnership, Trump Tariffs
item.description: FitLab Inc., which makes cardio equipment and runs boutique fitness studios, said it filed bankruptcy following disruptions to its supply chain and the loss of a key deal with Nike Inc.

item.title: Binance’s $6.3 billion cyberattack began with fake job offers: Co-CEO Richard Teng reveals details
item.description: Binance says hackers it attributes to North Korea stole $6.3 billion through a months-long campaign involving fake job interviews, malicious developer tools, compromised devices and AI techniques.

item.title: Cancer drugs from space? Why pharma firms are looking beyond Earth to manufacture next-gen medicines
item.description: Pharma companies are exploring space-based manufacturing to grow drug crystals in microgravity, potentially improving cancer drug formulations. Companies such as Varda and BioOrbit are testing whether orbiting laboratories can make next-gen medicines commercially viable.

item.title: Who is Tewolde Gebremariam? Why is Air India's new CEO in the news? What did he say? Know here
item.description: Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam says the airline's full turnaround could take 15-20 years as it plans to expand its widebody fleet and long-haul operations.

item.title: Unilever looks to India to deliver what China did for rivals: CEO
item.description: Unilever plans to apply its India strategy across emerging markets, where it sees an advantage in distribution, product range and market share.

item.title: Indigo hired 600 pilots in FY26, 400 more to join by next year amid rising fuel costs and quarterly loss: Report
item.description: InterGlobe Aviation, which operates IndiGo, continued its quarterly losses to a third consecutive quarter in September. The airlines reported a net loss of ₹1,879 crore in the quarter.

item.title: Who is Helen Chiang? Microsoft promoted her to Xbox COO in July. What led to her exit months later? What went wrong?
item.description: Helen Chiang, who was appointed Xbox's first-ever chief operating officer in July 2026, has disputed reports about the circumstances of her departure from Microsoft.&nbsp;

item.title: Orkla India’s revenue rises 19.4% in Q2, but volume growth remains subdued
item.description: Orkla expects some of the margin pressure to ease as price increases taken after the latest round of industry-wide cost inflation begin to flow through.

item.title: Aurtus partners with WTS Global to boost cross-border tax and regulatory advisory services
item.description: Indian tax and regulatory advisory firm Aurtus has joined WTS Global, expanding cross-border services for Indian businesses and international companies. Founded in 2020, Aurtus has more than 75 professionals and offices in Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Ahmedabad and GIFT City.

item.title: Uber flags fuel-cost impact on India mobility business
item.description: Rising fuel prices are weighing on Uber's mobility operations in India and Brazil, where price sensitivity among riders and drivers is more pronounced, even as demand remains strong.

item.title: 3M to pay $7.35 billion to settle 'forever chemicals' injury claims involving up to 120,000 plaintiffs
item.description: PFAS, or per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, are a group of manufactured chemicals widely used in products designed to resist heat, stains, grease and water.

item.title: Canva layoffs: Amid job cuts, check severance package offered to 1,271 employees - 6 months' salary, MacBooks and more
item.description: In an email sent to employees on November 4, Canva CEO Melanie Perkins outlined the changes and explained the reasons behind the decision.

item.title: Nykaa pushes quick commerce expansion as Q2 profit more than doubles
item.description: Nykaa Now is targeting a presence in more than 25 cities by FY27, as the beauty retailer looks to drive repeat purchases and incremental demand through faster deliveries. The company also reported a 207% year-on-year rise in Q2 net profit to ₹101 crore.

item.title: JSW Dulux sees strong paint demand but struggles to pass on rising costs
item.description: The paint maker reported 21% volume growth in the September quarter but is absorbing part of rising input costs, wary that further price increases could dampen consumption.

item.title: SpaceX taps Qualcomm to power Starlink Mobile in challenge to Verizon, AT&T in US wireless market
item.description: SpaceX has partnered with Qualcomm to build terrestrial network infrastructure for Starlink Mobile, taking on US wireless giants Verizon, AT&amp;T and T-Mobile.

item.title: CVS Health Split: Healthcare giant to separate 9,000 stores in one of the industry's biggest-ever breakups
item.description: CVS Health plans to separate its roughly 9,000 retail pharmacies into a publicly traded company, CVS Pharmacy, in the first half of 2028. CVS Health will retain Aetna and Caremark. The move follows a strategic review as the company pursues cost cuts and works to improve its business.

item.title: Dabur Q2 profit up 12%, margins under pressure
item.description: The company also announced the exit of global chief executive Mohit Malhotra, who is set to take up an overseas leadership role.

item.title: Amul butter, ghee prices hiked by up to ₹50 from 4 November | Check new rates
item.description: Amul has increases prices of its butter and ghee products by up to ₹50, as per a report. Its most popular Amul Butter now costs ₹66 from ₹63.

item.title: IndiGo reportedly in talks to buy 100 Embraer jets, may place order for 50 more: What we know
item.description: The proposed deal, which could be worth billions of dollars at list prices, would mark a significant expansion of IndiGo's aircraft portfolio beyond its existing Airbus narrowbody jets and ATR turboprop fleet.

item.title: Equitas SFB names Balaji Nuthalapadi as interim CEO
item.description: Equitas Small Finance Bank has asked Balaji Nuthalapadi, a board member who spent 28 years at Citi, to run the lender temporarily. He steps in after founder P.N. Vasudevan quit, saying investors kept questioning his daughter’s link to a separate lending firm.

item.title: Google expands voluntary buyouts to 5 more countries after hiring spree: Is India included?
item.description: Google is expanding voluntary buyout offers to employees in Canada, France, Germany, Japan and Switzerland as it seeks to control costs while investing heavily in artificial intelligence.

item.title: NBCC’s WTC project at Delhi’s Nauroji Nagar receives GRIHA provisional 4-star rating: Here’s all you need to know
item.description: NBCC’s World Trade Centre project in New Delhi has received a provisional four-star GRIHA rating. What does the recognition mean? A look at India’s green building rating system, why it was developed and how it assesses environmental performance across a building’s life cycle.

item.title: Delhi HC draws line, says national capital cannot be default venue for every brand dispute
item.description: The court said companies must show that the dispute has a genuine connection with Delhi.

item.title: Bharti Airtel Q2 preview: Higher Arpu, subscriber upgrades to drive earnings
item.description: Discontinuation of lower-priced prepaid plans, premiumization and growth in Africa are expected to lift revenue, while investors watch for subscriber churn and the scope for further tariff hikes.
